dashboard_zones.dashboard_name: Tourism In Canada - What Provinces have the highest growth rates from 2014-17? Where do most of the tourists originate from in BC?

text_runs.text: Q#1 Highest Growth: Of the selected high demand provinces highlighted British Columbia has the highest tourism demand growth rate of 25% from 2014-2017. *note: Although technically the smaller greyed out provinces show a higher growth rate, their total demand compared to my chosen coloured privinces are so small I chose not to focus on them*

Q#2 Where are majority of tourist origins: Using BC as an example, most of the tourists come from within the province (domestic) or internationally. About 41% and 38%  each respectively and BC only has about 20% of tourist demand from other canadian provinces.
